documentation.content:
This alert covers the nightly usage rollup Cloud Run Job.

Runbook:
- Cloud Run Job: usage-rollup-job (asia-south1)
- Check latest execution logs.
- If failures: inspect [usage_rollup_scheduler] logs for the tenantId target(s) and error message(s).

Note: Cloud Monitoring conditionAbsent only supports up to 23h30m, so we do not use a missing-heartbeat condition for a once-per-day job. If you want a missing-run alert, use Cloud Scheduler metrics/alerts or run the rollup more frequently.
